snippet.title: Amiga 500 Longplay [229] Little Red Riding Hood
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Ironclaw

This is the third and final game in the "Once Upon a Time" series. The other two previous ones were Baba Yaga and Abracadabra. Might be more, but I couldn't find any other ones.

I wrote a bunch for the other two, but can't be bothered again for this one. All three are quite similar, especially the first two, but this one differs a bit from the other ones. If you watch the other two and read their video descriptions, and then watch this video (before or after), you'll see what's different... I guess :) *yawn*.... 2 AM...

Baba Yaga longplay: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XpwFNoOEBeE
Abracadabra longplay: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aEetleSfi9I -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
